[2026-08-28T22:20:42.719Z] [player] Ask about her work
[2026-08-28T22:20:42.721Z] [world] "Plate," Irma says, without looking up. "Everything else is decoration you bleed through." She turns the piece she is working, finds a seam, and hits it once. "You want light, go to Halem. You want to walk home, you come here."
[2026-08-28T22:20:42.724Z] [world] Irma Ironhand keeps working while she talks — a rag over a joint, a thumb testing an edge that did not need testing.
[2026-08-28T22:20:43.419Z] [player] Ask about the Giants
[2026-08-28T22:20:43.419Z] [world] "The encampments." She sets the hammer down, which she does not often do. "My mother's people. They went up the ridge when the mud came and they never came back down — not because they cannot. Because down here you all still argue about whose flood it was." A pause. "I came down. Somebody has to make the armour."
[2026-08-28T22:20:43.420Z] [world] There is a burn on the back of Irma Ironhand's hand old enough to have stopped being a story.
[2026-08-28T22:20:44.102Z] [player] Ask why her prices never move
[2026-08-28T22:20:44.103Z] [world] "Because the iron does not care what season it is." Irma keeps working. "Halem haggles. Tellin haggles. They sell things people want. I sell the difference between a woun
d and a bruise, and that has cost the same since the water."
[2026-08-28T22:20:44.107Z] [world] Something in the back of Irma Ironhand's shop ticks over and settles, and she does not look up at it.
[2026-08-28T22:20:44.836Z] [world] You let the conversation go and Irma Ironhand gets back to it.

[2026-08-28T22:21:50.852Z] [player] Ask how business is
[2026-08-28T22:21:50.853Z] [world] "Business is people," Halem says cheerfully, moving a crate that did not need moving. "Everything on this post came off somebody who needed something else more. I do not think there is a single new thing in Tartaria. Just things that have changed hands enough times to look new."
[2026-08-28T22:21:50.853Z] [world] Halem the Trader shifts the pack higher on his shoulder and does not put it down.
[2026-08-28T22:21:51.453Z] [player] Ask about the trading post
[2026-08-28T22:21:51.455Z] [world] "It was my father's, and it was not a post then, it was a front room." He gestures at the roof, which is three different roofs. "Every bit of this is somebody's payment. That beam is a 
debt. That shutter is a debt. I have been paid in doors more times than in coin." He grins. "Do not tell anybody. It is the only reason I have a building."
[2026-08-28T22:21:51.457Z] [world] Halem the Trader looks at the road behind you before he answers anything at all.

[2026-08-28T22:21:52.622Z] [player] Ask about the acid trade
[2026-08-28T22:21:52.624Z] [world] "Careful with that shelf." Halem slides a wax-sealed flask an inch further from your elbow. "Battery bile. The old world kept its lightning in acid — jar-batteries taller than a house, vault floors full of them. The flood shorted the lightning out and left the bile leaking for a thousand years. Scavengers milk the jars that held; I cut it with aether dust so it e
ats armor instead of hands." He taps the wax. "Sells to people who plan on winning slowly."
[2026-08-28T22:21:52.627Z] [world] Halem the Trader keeps facing the way he was going, and talks to you sideways.
